findings.title: Distinguish adjacent Computer MIDI text from per-binding prerequisites
findings.authoring_location: derive.py build(): blanket contexts entry for table27 and context_scope literal source prerequisites
findings.problem: Every table27 row receives KN2:B350/B351 as explicit_context_blocks labeled literal source prerequisites. B350 introduces enabled Computer MIDI playable-note/octave/velocity use and the following diagram; it does not state that Computer MIDI must already be enabled to toggle MIDI Map, Key Map or Computer MIDI itself. B351 is general single-letter-plus-Shift context, not a proved per-row prerequisite or forced modifier for any of the five rows. The strongest unsupported B350 associations are rows287–289 (three toggles); the B351 role is overassigned across all five.

primary_source_evidence.text: Toggle MIDI Map Mode | Ctrl M | Cmd M
Toggle Key Map Mode | Ctrl K | Cmd K
When the Computer MIDI Keyboard is enabled, you can play notes and adjust the octave and velocity ranges using the following keys:
Single letter shortcuts can still be used when the Computer MIDI Keyboard is active by adding Shift, e.g., ShiftS to solo a track.

findings.source_scope: Retained shortcut chapter42.24, exact raw table followed by B350, uninspected Computer MIDI diagram/caption and B351. Source hashes/locators and original292 binding rows are correct; this finding concerns association role, not malformed extraction or target behavior.
findings.impact: Discovery-only/null grading prevents a current behavior pass, but the source audit still mislabels neighboring explanatory text as explicit prerequisites and could misdirect a later owner reconciliation. K23 proposal prose is already narrower and does not require a new keyboard exception.
findings.required_change: Create a preserved narrow successor distinguishing supported row-specific prerequisites from adjacent/general context. Do not label B350 as an enabled prerequisite for the three mapping/keyboard toggle rows, and retain B351 as general context rather than an asserted prerequisite for each table27 row. Preserve exact source text, all292 original bindings, Q052 source differences and all null/U/unexecuted/zero-completion fields. Do not invent dispatch or Shift exceptions. Keep genuinely supported enabled playable-note/octave/velocity context separate; an explicit context-role field or similarly narrow role distinction is sufficient.

Source-specific menu/Settings entry, ControlBar group/help, mixer traversal, Arrangement track up/down and locator/grid actions are marked missing rather than inferred from broader focus cases.

NAV028 generic pending-point movement versus explicit left/right gesture, NAV030 already-selected/type versus Enter-select-existing and up/down value routes, and visual focused/selected/moved-Undo feedback are separately represented as missing/partial contexts.
